headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russian Druzhba Oil Pipeline Station and Refinery
summary: Ukrainian drone strikes targeted the Kaleykino pumping station—a critical hub for Russia's Druzhba pipeline—and the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Products Plant, damaging energy export infrastructure.
why: The Druzhba pipeline is one of the world's longest crude oil networks, supplying refineries across Eastern and Central Europe.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Attacks on Russian export pipeline hubs heighten geopolitical energy disruption risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Military strikes on key Russian pipeline infrastructure heightened supply concern in global oil markets.
